import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import type { TagContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Tag extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        mode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        selectedIds: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        appliedBarId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        activeId: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        clearActive: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: TagContract['items'];
    mode: NonNullable<TagContract['mode']>;
    selectedIds: readonly string[] | undefined;
    appliedBarId: string;
    private activeId;
    private clearActive;
    private localSelected;
    private removal?;
    private restoreRemoval;
    private pendingAdd;
    private pendingClear;
    private enterControl;
    private enterIdentity;
    private enterMode;
    constructor();
    private toggle;
    willUpdate(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private controls;
    private focusControl;
    private key;
    private keyUp;
    updated(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
